title: Distinguish or Homogenize: Last-Chance Policy Identification and Risk-Budgeted Recovery under Irreversible Resource Depletion
abstract: arXiv:2609.36741v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Under irreversible resource depletion, an agent can spend resources to distinguish among latent fault models, or to change the system state so that the remaining models admit a common acceptable continuation--at which point further diagnosis becomes unnecessary. This distinguish-or-homogenize principle identifies a path that existing frameworks for identification, planning, and diagnosis do not make explicit: prior formulations treat the mapping from fault models to acceptable policies as a given, whereas LCPI makes it a function of the agent's own actions. We formalize this principle through Last-Chance Policy Identification (LCPI), where correctness is evaluated at the state the agent reaches rather than at the initial state. The Last Identifiable Margin (LIM) marks the feasibility boundary between distinguishing and homogenizing. For deterministic diagnostic graphs we provide the Exact-LIM recursion; for noisy finite-horizon recovery

translated_title: 区分还是同质化：不可逆资源耗竭下的最后机会策略识别与风险预算恢复
translated_abstract: 在不可逆资源耗竭的情境下，智能体既可以消耗资源来区分潜在的故障模型，也可以改变系统状态，使剩余的模型都允许一个共同的可接受后续路径——此时进一步的诊断便不再必要。这一“区分还是同质化”原则揭示了现有识别、规划与诊断框架未曾明确指出的一条路径：以往的形式化将故障模型到可接受策略的映射视为既定事实，而LCPI将其变为智能体自身行动的函数。我们通过最后机会策略识别（LCPI）对这一原则进行形式化，其中正确性是在智能体所到达的状态而非初始状态处进行评估的。最后可辨识裕度（LIM）标记了区分与同质化之间的可行性边界。对于确定性诊断图，我们给出了Exact-LIM递归；对于带噪声的有限时域恢复（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“区分还是同质化”原则，通过最后机会策略识别（LCPI）框架将故障模型到可接受策略的映射变为智能体自身行动的函数，并以最后可辨识裕度（LIM）刻画区分与同质化两种策略之间的可行性边界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the distinguish-or-homogenize principle through the Last-Chance Policy Identification (LCPI) framework, which reformulates the mapping from fault models to acceptable policies as a function of the agent's own actions, with the Last Identifiable Margin (LIM) marking the feasibility boundary between distinguishing and homogenizing.
